item.title: Leon Kennedy Is Confirmed For Resident Evil Requiem
item.description: The legend returns.: Leon Kennedy has finally been confirmed to appear in Resident Evil Requiem; though perhaps not in the way that Capcom had hoped.Yes, as reported by IGN, the veteran character now shows up via the PSN store when users go to the pre-download page. The updated key art shows Leon in the background behind the game's other key protagonist, Grace Ashcroft.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Video: Here's Your First Look At The Street Fighter Live-Action Movie, Due Out 2026
item.description: This trailer goes HARD!At The Game Awards, Street Fighter fans got a surprise teaser of the upcoming live-action movie, due out in 2026.It's a high-energy sneak peek with some interesting cinematography, fight scenes that would look right at home in a martial arts movie, and even the bonus stage where you beat the hell of a car.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Video: LEGO Batman: Legacy Of The Dark Knight 'Official Heroes & Villains Trailer'
item.description: Switch 2 release date to be announced "soon".Following the announcement of LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight for the Switch 2 in August, Warner Bros. Games has now shared a brand new trailer focused on the heroes and villains of the series.Alongside this news is a release date for other platforms - confirming a 29th May 2026 launch, with a "Switch 2 launch date to be announced soon". For now the Switch 2 version is simply locked in for a 2026 release.Read the full article on nintendolife.co

item.title: A New Tomb Raider Entry Has Leaked Ahead Of The Game Awards
item.description: Update: Reimagining of OG game and "all-new entry" revealed.: The Game Awards is taking place later today (or early tomorrow depending on your timezone), but it seems that yet another major announcement has leaked ahead of schedule.As reported by Eurogamer, the cover art for a new Tomb Raider entry has cropped up online along with a handful of screenshots. item.title: Video: New 007 First Light Trailer Introduces Lenny Kravitz As Bawma
item.description: Out next year for Switch 2.IO Interactive is gearing up to release 007 First Light next year on the Switch 2, and ahead of this anticipated release, a new teaser trailer has been shared at The Game Awards, introducing the new character Bawma.He's played by the singer and musician Lenny Kravitz, and is described as being the "largest black-market dealer in the Western Hemisphere". As you can see in the trailer above, he'll be feeding Bond to the girls!Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Phasmophobia Brings "Genre-Defining" Co-Op Horror Madness To Switch 2 In 2026
item.description: Stay alert.One of the many spooky surprises at The Game Awards this year was the announcement Phasmophobia, the highly popular co-op psychological horror title, would be making its way to the Switch 2 in 2026.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Mega Man Returns In 2027 With A "Brand-New Entry" For Switch And Switch 2
item.description: Here's a first look at the gameplay.Perhaps one of the biggest surprises of The Game Awards this year was the announcement of Mega Man: Dual Override for the Switch and Switch 2. It will be releasing on Nintendo systems (and other platforms) at some point in 2027.Along with this news was a first look at the gameplay, it doesn't really show all that much, but it does appear to feature the same type of platforming action fans know and love. item.title: The Game Awards GOTY For 2025 Is Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
item.description: Nintendo also took home some awards.The Game Awards for 2025 has wrapped, and Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 by French studio Sandfall Interactive has officially been crowned 'Game of the Year'.In case you missed it, the competition included Death Stranding 2: On the Beach, Donkey Kong Bananza, Hades II, Hollow Knight: Silksong and Kingdom Come: Deliverance II.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Super Mario Galaxy Movie Gets A New Teaser Trailer At The Game Awards
item.description: Mario & Luigi vs. Bowser Jr.At The Game Awards, Nintendo and Illumination surprised fans with another look at the upcoming Super Mario Galaxy Movie.It features Bowser Jr. taking on Mario and Luigi in a very brief teaser. Some not-so-pleasant introductions are exchanged, and before you know it, the younger Bowser is smashing everything in sight. Fortunately, Luigi steps in to save the day (and Mario).Read the full article on nintendolife.com
